labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when PRs will be enabled for external contributors; this is contribution process, which the triage table routes to question.

items.body:
Pull requests are currently limited to collaborators, so please describe the change in an issue first. The contribution steps are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md), and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) applies if AI tools helped write the fix. An earlier closed request about PRs from forks is #4029, which may be useful background.

If you open an issue for the broken link, naming the link and the page it is on will make it quick to check.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
